gloss: to rewrite; to transfer (a registration); to renew

definitions.gloss: to rewrite; to transfer or renew (a title, registration, or document)
definitions.explanation: To write something over again, or to update an official record by replacing the old entry with a new one. The {替|か}え here stresses substituting new content for the old; the same verb is more commonly written {書|か}き{換|か}える.

examples.japanese: ⟦{原稿|げんこう}→原稿：00064_genkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{替|か}える。
⟦{名義|めいぎ}→名義：10623_meigi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{替|か}える⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I went through the procedure to transfer the name on the title.

examples.japanese: ⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{登記|とうき}→登記：19798_touki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{替|か}える⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: We need to transfer the registration of the land.

examples.japanese: ⟦{株主|かぶぬし}→株主：15274_kabunushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{帳簿|ちょうぼ}→帳簿：07961_choubo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名義|めいぎ}→名義：10623_meigi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{替|か}えた。
examples.english: Since the shareholder changed, we transferred the name in the ledger.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧), taking ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ for what is rewritten or transferred.

USAGE:
- ⟦{名義|めいぎ}→名義：10623_meigi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{替|か}える: to transfer the name on a title or registration
- ⟦{登記|とうき}→登記：19798_touki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{替|か}える: to update a registration

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{書|か}き{換|か}える→書き換える：08225_kakikaeru⟧: the more common spelling of the same verb
- ⟦{書|か}き{直|なお}す→書き直す：04597_kakinaosu⟧: to rewrite — implies correcting or improving the text
